items.content:
Blue Line, between Damen and Division. Couldn't get a breath in. A woman
asked if I was okay and I said yes in a voice that clearly said no and
she sat back down, which honestly I appreciated.

Embarrassed all day. Still am. Writing it down so it's somewhere other
than my chest.

summary: A panic attack on the Blue Line and a stranger's kindness
title: the train thing
